['Berliner Wasserbetriebe '].company_description: Berliner Wasserbetriebe is responsible for water supply and sanitation provision in Berlin, Germany. The company ensures universal and good quality water supply and sanitation services, with a focus on low per capita water use, advanced wastewater treatment, and low distribution losses. The sector is regulated by municipalities and professional associations, with recent developments including the trend to create commercial public utilities under private law and efforts to modernize the sector.
